content.description: Electric control circuit diagram showing the automatic transmission electrical system. The diagram includes battery connection through ignition switch, indicator (combination meter), neutral start switch, A/TM connection, speed sensor, solenoid connections (+B, IG, PWR, IDL, ECT ECU, with numbered terminals L1, L2, L3, SP1, SP2, DG, GND, OD1, OD2), engine ECU, rheostat, pattern select switch, light control relay, light control switch, C/C computer, OD switch, stop light switch, and ECU-IG fuse (15A) and stop fuse (15A).

Component location diagram showing a top-down cutaway view of a Toyota Supra with automatic transmission components labeled. The diagram shows the physical locations of various sensors, switches, and control units throughout the vehicle, including components in the engine bay, under the dashboard, and along the transmission.
